entities.name: Kavaronic Federal Empire
entities.description: The Kav government on Kavaron in the Edge, which administers Kavaron Before and the Kav Memorial Navy and seeks new worlds to settle.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: An old empire forced to make a home among the stars by climate collapse and tectonic destabilization.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The Kav homeworld, torn apart by cataclysms; Kavaron Before is its stabilized half.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The interstellar navy of the Kavaronic Empire, of converted mining vessels, tasked with protecting and retrieving remains of Kavaron.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Whose collapse of Sothera into a supervoid slowed the system's death.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Star collapsed into a supervoid by the Monoists.

entities.name: Vu
entities.description: Ancient capital and last imperial city of the Kav, policed by memorial teams.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: World being remade by the Eumidians, which the Kav plan to invade.

entities.name: Exodus Day
entities.description: Day the first Kav shuttle lifted refugees off Kavaron.

events.summary: The Kav accelerate destructive mining to lift their species and biome off-world as cataclysms tear Kavaron apart.
events.quote: the Kav accelerated their extensive yet destabilizing mining projects

events.summary: The Monoists collapse Sothera into a supervoid, slowing the system's death.
events.quote: giving the Kav time to leave their planet

events.summary: On Exodus Day the first Kav shuttle lifts the first refugees off Kavaron.
events.quote: the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface

events.summary: The Kavaronic Empire designs invasion plans to seize Evendo after the Eumidians finish remaking it.
events.quote: already designing invasion plans to take the world for its own

relations.quote: It administers the affairs of Kavaron Before and the Kav Memorial Navy

relations.note: plans to take Evendo from them
relations.quote: once the Eumidians have finished remaking it
